serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to a `bash-language-server` executable. Leave empty to use the bundled server.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which parts of the Bash server the editor uses. Turning one off hands it to the next server serving the same file.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Report parser and ShellCheck findings in the linter.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Offer variables, functions, executables, builtins, keywords, options and snippets.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: Show definitions and command documentation on hover.

definition.title: Go To Definition
definition.description: Jump to a variable or function declaration.

references.title: Find References
references.description: List uses of a variable or function.

symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description: Serve document and project symbols to go-to-symbol.

outline.title: Outline
outline.description: Fill the outline panel with variables and functions.

format.title: Format
format.description: Format shell scripts with shfmt when it is available.

rename.title: Rename
rename.description: Rename a variable or function in its resolved scope.

codeActions.title: Code Actions
codeActions.description: Offer ShellCheck fixes in the intentions list.

bashIde.title: Bash Language Server
bashIde.description: Workspace analysis and external tools used by the language server.

backgroundAnalysisMaxFiles.title: Background Analysis Limit
backgroundAnalysisMaxFiles.description: Maximum workspace files parsed in the background. Set to 0 to disable background analysis.

globPattern.title: Workspace File Pattern
globPattern.description: Glob used to find shell scripts for cross-file symbols, navigation and completion.

includeAllWorkspaceSymbols.title: All Workspace Symbols
includeAllWorkspaceSymbols.description: Include every symbol found in the workspace, rather than only symbols from sourced files.

enableSourceErrorDiagnostics.title: Source Error Diagnostics
enableSourceErrorDiagnostics.description: Report missing or unreadable sourced files. Ignored when all workspace symbols are included.

explainshellEndpoint.title: Explainshell Endpoint
explainshellEndpoint.description: Explainshell-compatible server used for command-option hover documentation. Leave empty to disable it.

logLevel.title: Log Level
logLevel.description: Minimum server message severity written to the language-server log.

shellcheckPath.title: ShellCheck Path
shellcheckPath.description: ShellCheck executable name or path. Leave empty to disable ShellCheck diagnostics and fixes.

shellcheckExternalSources.title: ShellCheck External Sources
shellcheckExternalSources.description: Let ShellCheck follow source directives. Disable this for projects whose source graph makes ShellCheck consume excessive memory.

shellcheckArguments.title: ShellCheck Arguments
shellcheckArguments.description: Additional arguments passed to ShellCheck, excluding the shell, output format, and external-sources flags managed by the server.

shfmt.title: shfmt
shfmt.description: Executable and formatting style used for document formatting.

path.title: Path
path.description: shfmt executable name or path. Leave empty to disable formatting.

ignoreEditorconfig.title: Ignore EditorConfig
ignoreEditorconfig.description: Always use these settings instead of shfmt options from `.editorconfig`.

languageDialect.title: Language Dialect
languageDialect.description: Shell dialect parsed and formatted by shfmt.

binaryNextLine.title: Binary Operators On Next Line
binaryNextLine.description: Allow `&&` and `||` to begin a continuation line.

funcNextLine.title: Function Brace On Next Line
funcNextLine.description: Place a function's opening brace on a separate line.

simplifyCode.title: Simplify Code
simplifyCode.description: Apply shfmt's safe simplifications while formatting.

spaceRedirects.title: Space Redirects
spaceRedirects.description: Put a space after redirection operators.
